caption: The drawing features a single glass object that is depicted centrally on a plain light background. The glass is tinted a translucent green and has a conical shape that widens towards the rim, with a thickened, rounded lip at the top. The body of the glass tapers downward and sits atop a circular, decorative base with a fluted or ruffled edge, also shaded in green. There are subtle white highlights and shading on the surface of the glass to suggest reflections and transparency. Below the image, there are handwritten words: "Toddy Glass" on the left and "Minnetta Good" on the right.
title: Toddy Glass
